basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Full-Stack AI Engineer | Production Agentic Systems | Founder & End-to-End Shipper
basics.summary: Full-stack engineer who ships AI-native product features end to end: frontend, backend, agent workflows, and the reliability layer that keeps them working under real usage. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps building production multi-agent workflows on Python and Google ADK, streamed live to the UI, with evals, tracing, and cost-per-request instrumentation on top; 2x outbound conversions, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue. Run Anand Creations on the side and have founded three AI products (PulseView, Proplab, SwissNRI), each taken from idea to real users solo. 13+ years across full-stack systems for 10M+ users, cross-team ownership, and the pragmatic trade-offs that make agents work in production.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI. ReAct with self-reflection for planning and recovery, tools exposed over MCP, agent state streamed live to the UI over AG-UI with partial results and tight latency. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $1M in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Grounds RAG so agents stop hallucinating and long-running workflows keep persistent context.

Owned the reliability layer: eval pipelines, LangSmith tracing, tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request instrumentation, and on-call for global production. Fallback and retry paths for LLM and tool failures. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated; product team ships in new languages without a gatekeeper.

Built AI Onboarding Specialist and a GenAI demo generator that auto-compose personalized streams from Salesforce data. LLM-powered product features shipped end to end (backend, prompts, UI); improved demo speed, close rates, time-to-first-value.
Designed a distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90% and now powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users). Full-stack, Product Owner of the feature.
Ran observability and on-call for global production systems (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io). Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort; engineers now lead features independently.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Shipped end-to-end delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL) with operator UI and real-time flight-control APIs. 500+ autonomous last-mile deliveries in the real world.
Built CI/CD and AWS infrastructure from scratch (Docker, Terraform). Enterprise reliability that enabled Unilever partnership and a CES showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS; secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics. Supervised 20+ master's students on optimization, neural controllers, and embodied learning. Foundational AI craft that underpins my agentic work today.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence for retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data; if the model cannot explain the signal it does not ship. Built solo end to end (product, agent stack, UI, streaming) and shipped to live users on real-time feeds.

projects.name: Proplab - AI-Native Property Workflows
projects.description: Vision pipeline extracts structured signals (room type, condition, defects) from inspection photos, replacing paper reports with queryable data. LLM agents then compose multilingual, marketing-ready listings end to end. One flow from photo to published listing, zero copy-paste. Idea to production, solo.

projects.name: Anand Creations - AI Products & Forward Deployed Engineering
projects.description: Independent studio and home for the AI-native products I design, build, and ship on my own (PulseView, Proplab, SwissNRI). Full-stack, AI at the core, concept to real customers.
